update.name: Server gameRoom.ts — Final: WebSocket + Skill Logging + Provably Fair
update.context: gameRoom.ts is the final server patch. It is the authoritative game state for all multiplayer modes (VS, Rally, Heist). It also logs skill analytics for every session including SOLO modes when played with a connected client. Server is Express v5 + ws (WebSocket). Database is sql.js (NOT better-sqlite3). Supabase is used for analytics inserts only — not for session game state. This patch must run LAST in the E block. All prior patches must be complete. The Detector/Transformer pipeline (V3 architecture) runs entirely server-side.

dependencies.dep: update-39 — useEnergy constants available for server mirror
update-40 — useGame round flow logic to mirror server-side

constraints.constraint: sql.js ONLY for local storage — never better-sqlite3 (arm64 incompatible).
Supabase analytics inserts are fire-and-forget — never await in message handlers.
CASCADE uses setTimeout recursion — never setInterval.
100ms input lock enforced server-side per player — reject chains within 100ms.
Bombs are Cell.type values — no activeBombs array in GameRoom state.
Import from @farkle/engine — never relative paths to packages/.
No Math.random() for any game event — HMAC-SHA256 CSPRNG only.
No better-sqlite3 import — rejected at farkle rule level.

do-not.rule: Do not use better-sqlite3 — sql.js only.
Do not await Supabase analytics calls in the message handler path.
Do not add activeBombs array to GameRoom state.
Do not use setInterval for cascade or energy ticking.
Do not use Math.random() for seeds, spawns, or game events.
Do not use relative import paths — use @farkle/ workspace aliases.
Do not regenerate SpawnPool — SixPoolManager only.
Do not use rallyGridSize() — use multiplayerGridSize().
